name: Grain
description: Video messaging and meeting recording/transcription platform with an API for meeting notes, recordings, and real-time events.
primary_blocker: API access requires a paid subscription tier (Starter, Business, or Enterprise).

evidence.claim: Grain API provides endpoints to read meeting data, manage recordings, and receive real-time events.
Grain supports OAuth2 Authorization Code flow, Personal Access Tokens (PAT), and Workspace Access Tokens (WAT).
Personal API access is available on Starter plan and above.

notes: Personal API access (PAT) is available on Starter plan and above, while Workspace Access Tokens (WAT) require Business and Enterprise plans.
